terminals.name: app
terminals.description: Telegram bot + web app on one process, sharing one SQLite DB (telegram-bot/data/football.db, auto-seeded on first run). Runs the full bot when TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN is set; otherwise starts only the web app + shared-DB API on port 3000 so the UI is developable without Telegram credentials.
terminals.command: cd telegram-bot && if [ -n "$TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN" ]; then npm start; else echo 'TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN not set — starting web app + shared-DB API only (Telegram bot disabled). Add TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN as a secret to enable the bot.'; node -e 'require("./src/server").startServer()'; fi
